title: 1st sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: After the opening recitation, with the longest-serving member presiding under Article 82(a) of the Constitution: forming a five-member temporary committee to count the secret ballots for electing the Speaker and Deputy Speaker.
Nominating and seconding members for the post of Speaker of the People's Majlis.
Nominating and seconding members for the post of Deputy Speaker of the People's Majlis.
Secret ballot to elect the Speaker of the People's Majlis under Article 82(a) of the Constitution.
Counting and announcing the result of the secret ballot for Speaker.
Secret ballot to elect the Deputy Speaker of the People's Majlis under Article 82(a) of the Constitution.
Counting and announcing the result of the secret ballot for Deputy Speaker.
Handing over the chair to the elected Speaker of the 20th People's Majlis.
Matter on the Standing Orders (rules of procedure) that Parliament must adopt under Article 88 of the Constitution.
Matter on forming Parliament's standing committees.

summary: The first sitting of the new Majlis was scheduled to elect its Speaker and Deputy Speaker by secret ballot and then take up its standing orders and committees.
